recipes.name: OREO Mini PHILLY Cheesecakes
ingredients_raw: 2 (250 g) packages PHILADELPHIA Brick Cream Cheese, softened
3 (1 ounce) squares BAKER'S Semi-Sweet Baking Chocolate
1 cup thawed COOL WHIP Whipped Topping

steps.text: Beat cream cheese and sugar in large bowl with mixer until well blended. Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating on low speed after each just until blended.
Place 1 cookie in bottom of each of 12 paper-lined muffin cups. Fill with batter.
Bake 20 minutes or until centres are almost set. Cool. Refrigerate 3 hours. Melt chocolate as directed on package; drizzle over cheesecakes. Top with COOL WHIP.

raw_recipe.headline: OREO Mini PHILLY Cheesecakes
raw_recipe.description: Whole Oreo cookies make a fun and tasty crust for chocolate-topped mini cheesecakes.

review.reviewBody: i altered this recipe to make 24 mini cheesecakes. I lined a mini muffin pan with liners and added just enough crushed oreos (12 regular sized crushed in a ziploc bag with a rolling pin) to cover the bottom. I halved the filling and it made just enough to fill all 24 liners to the top. I added a splash of vanilla to the filling as well and only cooked it for about 12 minutes, or until it was almost set. I topped them off with one mini oreo each, and it took almost the whole box of Snack Packs to do the job, as each baggie only had about 9 cookies in it :( overall, i was really pleased with how they turned out. Can't wait to eat them this weekend at a friend's party!

This recipe is very good, but like others suggested, I added 1tsp of vanilla to give the cheesecake that extra flavor missing. Remember, cheesecake doesn’t really rise, so fill your cups pretty full. After reading other reviews, I was expecting the cookie to be extremely hard. I dont know if it was because I used generic oreos, or if it was because I made them the night before, but my cookie was very soft. Also, to simplify the process even more, I used Smucher’s Magic Shell ice cream topping for the chocolate drizzle. After I baked them, I let them set for about 10mins, drizzled the MagicShell on top, then refrigerated overnight. Topping looked just as good and a lot less work. Thanks for the recipe!

I made this recipe for a potluck. Everyone loved them! I crushed the oreos in a plastic bag with a rolling pin and mixed with 3 tablespoons of melted butter, then pressed them into the liners and followed the rest of the recipe.

According to previous reviewers, the cheesecake had very little flavor, so I adapted this recipe by adding 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp sour cream, 1 tsp vanilla extract, zest of 1/2 a lemon, and crushed 9 oreos into the batter. I baked them for 15 minutes. It yielded about 18 mini cheesecakes, and they came out nicely.

Everyone loved them. I added the tsp. of vanilla as recommended. I didn’t have any regular sugar so I used Truvia substitute. No one noticed. I also used Oreo Thins for the base. It had just the right amount of crunch.

I absolutely loved this recipe. I placed the entire Oreo on the bottom of the muffin cup and added 1.5 teaspoons of vanilla as suggested by other reviewers. I am a total chocoholic so I also mixed in 1 cup of melted semisweet chocolate chips (prior to mixing in the eggs). I also only had to bake for 15 minutes and they were perfect. So chocolaty and delicious, I advise adding the melted chocolate if you are anything like me. Perfect recipe! Would make them without chocolate too and top with preserves (probably strawberry) yum!

Very simple Recipe...and a delicious dessert! I used the new "Oreo Thins" to line the bottom of each muffin tin liner...and crushed 6 Oreo's and added them to the Cheesecake batter, along with 1 teaspoon of Vanilla Extract. Quick & easy Dessert!

Added 8 oreos and 2tsp vanilla to the cream cheese, eggs, sugar. Cookie was hard like the others had mentioned, but I made for a retirement party and people raved. 

Next time, I will put a dollop of cheesecake mixture, then cookie.

Made 24 half full cheesecake cupcakes and 3 full ones

These were absolutely fantastic! They were so easy to make and were gone in less than 10 minutes. I followed the suggestions of many other reviewers and added 1 1/2 teaspoons of vanilla extract to a double batch of batter. I also used double stuffed oreos that i soaked in milk for a couple of seconds. Also, I used semisweet chocolate chips for the drizzle on the top. Also, i would suggest using foil cupcake wrappers instead of paper ones because the oreo stuck to the bottom a bit. I brought 24 of these mini cheesecakes to a tennis team dinner and everyone loved them! definitely a keeper.

I added some vanilla and 3/4 cup or so sour cream to the batter. I also dipped the Oreo in melted butter hoping this would help prevent them from being too crunchy. They were still crunchy but after 12 hours they seemed to soften a little. They turned out super yummy!

So yummy! I had made few changes just to suit my taste after reading other reviews:
-Instead of regular cream cheese, I used reduced fat. Worked just as nicely.
-I did add 1tsp of vanilla extract as reviews had suggested. 
-My oven bakes a little faster than normal, so I had to take them out 3.5 minutes early.
-To half the batch, i added dark chocolate chips once i poured them in. 
Will definitely make it again!
I have made these for good many year when I got your cook book with them in alway big hit where ever I take them .I change the the top to lemon apple caramel cherry many different tops so good

Shared this with lots of friends and family. Everyone loved it! It had just the right sweetness. I did add a tsp of vanilla like others suggested. I also made whipped cream for the tops, instead of cool whip.
i crushed up the cookies and mixed them with melted butter to make a crust instead and used the creams to flavor the batter. i then added crushed up oreos into the batter. they tasted great.

I made these for a new years eve gathering and forgot about them until same day. So I chopped up 12 Aldi double stuffed chocolate cookies as I had those in the pantry. Added a couple tablespoons of melted butter and then divided that between 12 muffin tins lined with paper. I did not have time to let the oreos soften so I thought I had to go this way. I tamped it down with a wooden tamper. Then I poured the cheesecake batter on that. I meant to add vanilla as others suggested and forgot. I filled the cups full. Then I baked them and let them set on counter maybe 20 minutes. Then I put them in the frig to cool. After a couple hours I topped them with a chocolate ganache. I did not have semi sweet chips so I used a hot cup of cream and poured that over a cup of dark chocolate chips and 1/3 cup of milk chocolate stars (improving with what I had). I did add a little vanilla (not my norm) into the ganache since I forgot it in the cheesecake batter. I spooned just a little ganache in the center of each one (boy I made way too much ganache) until it was basically level. Put them back in the frig for about an hour, then we had to run to the party. People loved these! Everyone asked for the recipe. So I gave it 5 stars even without vanilla. Doubled the batch today for another event and turned out beautiful.

As much as I want to like these, the cookie being crunchy really throws off the entire cupcake feel. Even for a crust, it would be too hard. Crushed, it would be too crumbly to eat while holding. Until the cookie can be made softer, you're better off making the mini version (with tweaks) because those ended up soft, in my experience.
So delicious. I took others’ advice and added vanilla and a couple crushed cookies to the batter, and skipped the topping.
I made it for a dessert nake off challenge and I won with this desert! It's really good!
It was so easy ... all my friends love it
I added half a bag of white chocolate melted with a little bit of heavy whipping cream. Gave a more rich flavor and helped with creating a velvet texture.
